content.title: A submission created in one browser session is not shown in a different browser session
content.intent: Prove that submission tracking is isolated to the browser session that created the submission, so a different browser session does not display that submission on `/my-submissions`.
content.technique_notes: Techniques: equivalence partitioning + negative / error + state / flow. I used two outcome-changing session partitions — the browser session that created the submission and a different browser session — because the source makes browser-session scoping an explicit visibility rule. No covering array was needed because there is one interaction axis; the risk-judged default strength would be 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss factor applies to this use-case.
